text: Learning from the university website that enthusiastic student assistants are wanted for the upcoming International Academic Symposium, I am writing to recommend myself with utmost enthusiasm.
As a senior majoring in English Literature, I am convinced that my qualifications match your requirements remarkably well.
First of all, I have achieved excellent proficiency in both oral and written English, which enables me to communicate fluently with foreign scholars.
Furthermore, having served as a liaison officer in previous university forums, I possess sound interpersonal skills and strong organizational capabilities.
Most importantly, I am dependable and fully committed to fulfilling every designated assignment with diligence.
Enclosed please find my curriculum vitae for your reference.
I would appreciate the opportunity to attend an interview at your convenience.
